caps.no_citation_no_score: A criterion with no source citation at all is 'unverifiable' by definition.

confidence_rules.derived: Computed from verified values (e.g. a weighted total, a rank delta). Inherits the weakest confidence of its inputs.
confidence_rules.estimated: An evaluator's judgment call with no citable record. Honest but soft — caps the criterion at 3.
confidence_rules.unverifiable: The claim cannot be checked from the evidence given. Scores no higher than 1, and must say so in the notes.
confidence_rules.verified: Backed by a source citation with a URL or document plus an observation date. Highest weight in disputes.

calibration.1: Barely distinguishable motif; no repeat intent.
calibration.2: Hook exists but buried or late; listener may miss it on first pass.
calibration.3: One solid hook; arrives mid-track; competent.
calibration.4: Clear single-level hook, arrives early, repeats cleanly.
calibration.5: Hook in the first 15 seconds and a new one every verse; quotable by strangers.

criteria.confidence_default: estimated — hook quality is a listening judgment. Cite the listener, the timestamp, or the play it came from.
criteria.name: Hook Density
criteria.scale: 0-5 integer. 5 = every 30 seconds carries a repeatable hook; 0 = no identifiable hook.
criteria.what_it_measures: How quickly and how often the track gives a listener something to grab — a vocal tag, a melody, a riff, a phrase worth repeating.

calibration.0: No verifiable play data at all.
calibration.1: Plays exist but flat; no replay signal.
calibration.2: Under 10,000 plays; a handful of saves; early traction only.
calibration.4: 50,000-249,999 verifiable lifetime plays, or documented save/repeat behavior on a public playlist.
calibration.5: playlist-scale conversion: >=250,000 verifiable lifetime plays with positive momentum. Reference: Zooted Zone by That Boy Hi Hat, 307,439 lifetime Spotify plays observed 2026-09-14 — the bar for this band.

criteria.confidence_default: verified when the play count comes from a public platform record or a DistroKid/Spotify data export with an observation date; otherwise estimated.
criteria.name: Replay Pull
criteria.scale: 0-5 integer. 5 = playlist-scale conversion already demonstrated; 0 = no evidence of replay.
criteria.what_it_measures: Whether real listeners came back — lifetime plays, saves, re-adds, repeats — not what they might do.

calibration.0: No lane describable in one sentence.
calibration.1: Genre claim only; no scene or comps.
calibration.2: Genre fuzzy; could be three different pitches.
calibration.3: Genre clear, lane crowded or undifferentiated.
calibration.4: Genre is clear, scene is emerging, comps exist.
calibration.5: Owns a named lane: genre + scene + comps all line up. Reference: That Boy Hi Hat — alternative rap / Post-Trap Futurism, one-lane pitch.

criteria.confidence_default: verified when the lane is stated in a published catalog record (e.g. cwi.catalog/1.0 artist.genre); otherwise estimated.
criteria.name: Lane Clarity
criteria.scale: 0-5 integer. 5 = a lane an A&R can pitch in one sentence; 0 = no lane.
criteria.what_it_measures: How sharply the track or artist owns a definable lane — genre, scene, audience — that a manager can actually pitch.

calibration.0: Rights disputed or track unreleasable for sync.
calibration.1: Explicit only, no clean path; rights unknown.
calibration.2: Rights uncertain; producer credits unresolved; cannot pitch without legal.
calibration.3: Rights ownership documented but splits unconfirmed; pitchable with a caveat.
calibration.4: Rights clear on paper; no clean or instrumental version; still pitchable.
calibration.5: Rights pre-cleared and documented; clean/instrumental versions exist; stems available; one-sheet written.

criteria.confidence_default: derived from the rights record. No one-stop or pre-cleared claims may be asserted without a document. Example: the That Boy Hi Hat catalog record (cwi.catalog/1.0) states no clean or instrumental versions exist and makes no pre-cleared rights claim — cap at 2 unless new evidence lands.
criteria.name: Sync Readiness
criteria.scale: 0-5 integer. 5 = pre-cleared, stems in hand, pitchable today; 0 = not sync-viable.
criteria.what_it_measures: How ready the track is for sync placement: rights clarity, clean versions, instrumentals, and a pitchable story.

calibration.0: No momentum evidence of any kind.
calibration.1: Stale claims only (6+ months); nothing recent.
calibration.2: Promises from curators; no verification. Treat as zero evidence until scanned.
calibration.3: Claimed adds with screenshots but no scan; older than 90 days.
calibration.4: One scan-verified playlist hold in the last 90 days, or two press hits with dates.
calibration.5: Multiple independent wins in the last 90 days, each scan-verified. Reference: three That Boy Hi Hat tracks holding on New Rap Hits — Shaka Zulu #21, Zooted Zone #30, Doves & Diamonds #31 — verified by full playlist scan 2026-09-15.

criteria.confidence_default: verified only when a scan, screenshot, or published record with a date backs it. Messenger claims and curator promises are untrustworthy until scanned — claimed-but-unverified momentum scores 2 at most.
criteria.name: Momentum Evidence
criteria.scale: 0-5 integer. 5 = multiple recent curator-validated wins; 0 = no momentum evidence.
criteria.what_it_measures: Independent, recent, verifiable momentum — playlist adds confirmed by scan, press with dates, curator receipts — not promises.

deal_breakers.action: Flag triggered; momentum_evidence from that source scores 0; note the vendor by name and URL.
deal_breakers.description: Any curator, playlist, or promoter in the evidence chain sells placements (pay-to-play adds, guaranteed adds). Their adds score 0 as momentum evidence and trigger this flag.

deal_breakers.action: Flag triggered; the claim is re-classed as claimed_but_unverified; momentum evidence re-scored to 2 at most.
deal_breakers.description: A curator promise, Messenger screenshot, or 'it's going up soon' was presented as a verified add without a scan.

deal_breakers.action: Flag triggered; sync_readiness caps at 0; verdict carries a red banner.
deal_breakers.description: Two parties claim the same track, splits are contested, or the beat is leased without clearance documentation.

deal_breakers.action: Flag triggered; replay_pull scores 0; verdict carries a red banner.
deal_breakers.description: Bots, engagement farms, click-for-click loops, or bought streams detected or reasonably suspected in the evidence.

deal_breakers.action: Flag triggered; overall verdict is a hard fail regardless of other scores.
deal_breakers.description: The artist or track cannot be found on any public platform — no streaming profile, no catalog record, no release.

description: A machine-native demo-evaluation protocol. Hand an agent any track or artist; get back a structured, source-cited verdict JSON (scores, deal-breakers, confidence labels) in one pass. Free. No login. No API key.
honest_by_construction: Every score must carry a confidence label and at least one source citation (URL + observation date). Scores without citable evidence are labeled 'estimated' or 'unverifiable' and score caps apply. A verdict is not a ranking chart; it is a citeable record of what an evaluator could actually verify.
how_it_works: Equip the config: fetch first-spin.json and first-spin-schema.json.
Feed the evaluator agent the target: one track or one artist, plus any sources you have (streaming data, playlist receipts, sync notes).
The evaluator scores the five criteria on a 0-5 scale, cites a source for every score, applies deal-breaker flags, and returns verdict JSON that validates against the schema.
The verdict composes: a pass feeds straight into the Gear Ledger (ledger handoff block below). A fail ships with exactly why, and what evidence would flip it.
ledger_compose_note: A passing verdict (75+) feeds the Gear Ledger as a candidate with the full verdict JSON attached. A failing verdict feeds the Ledger too — as a record of why, so the pipeline never re-litigates the same track blind.
ledger_handoff: CWI-HANDOFF gear=first-spin verdict=<weighted_percent> band=<band> from=<agent> to=<agent>

auto_cap_rules: Any deal-breaker triggered: verdict caps at 'develop' unless the flag is rights_disputed or no_verifiable_presence, which cap at 'pass'.
Estimated confidence caps its criterion at 3; unaverifiable caps at 1.
A criterion with zero citations is unaverifiable by definition.

verdict_bands.advance: 75-89 — Advance with conditions. The verdict notes exactly what evidence flips the band.
verdict_bands.develop: 50-74 — Develop. Real material, not ready for curators or sync.
verdict_bands.pass: 0-49 — Pass. Move on; the verdict says why, so nobody re-litigates it.
verdict_bands.sign: 90-100 — First-spin sign. Ready for the pipeline; pitch now.

cwi-default.name: CWI Default Taste Profile
cwi-default.notes: Calibrated against verified CWI catalog facts (Zooted Zone 307,439 plays; New Rap Hits holds #21/#30/#31). Prefer replay pull and momentum evidence over lane novelty; distrust unverified curator claims by default.
